description:
Im Han-sae has never liked Ji On-young. Not since their school days. He hated how Ji On-young was always one step ahead of him. One sweltering summer day, while waiting for a friend who never showed up, Han-sae ended up going to an escape room with Ji On-young. Ji On-young claimed he’d never tried one before—perfect. Han-sae thought it was the perfect chance to show off his brilliance.

[There’s only one way to escape!]

…Yeah. This wasn’t exactly what he’d planned to show off.
